questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Tattoos, why people get them and why they're popular
How to remove unwanted tattoos safely with lasers
The health risks of tattoos and the inks they use
Famous footballers and their fashion and hairstyles
questions.why: Sam and Rob discuss tattoos, why people have them and the recent trend.

questions.q: What are the presenters' feelings about tattoos at the start?
options: Both of them love tattoos and have several each
Rob likes them, but Sam thinks they look cheap
Sam finds them impressive, but Rob isn't keen
Both think they are ugly and a waste of money
questions.why: Sam says they can be impressive works of art; Rob says he's not that keen.

questions.q: Why does Lucie Parfitt like tattoos?
options: All her friends at university have them too
She sees them as a creative way to show who she is
She wants to look like her favourite celebrity
She works as an artist in a tattoo parlour
questions.why: She says they're a cool way of expressing yourself and her personality creatively.

questions.q: What does Sam suggest if you want to express something different later?
options: Have the old tattoo removed
Cover it with clothes
Stop getting tattoos
Get a new tattoo
questions.why: Sam says, 'Well, then it's time for a new tattoo!'

questions.q: How many people now have a tattoo, according to Rob?
options: One in ten
One in five
One in two
One in twenty
questions.why: Rob says he's heard that one in five people now have a tattoo.

questions.q: According to tattoo artist Lee Clements, what has changed in the last ten years?
options: Tattoos have become cheaper
Tattoo artists are better trained
Many celebrities have tattoos, so people copy them
Young people have stopped getting tattoos
questions.why: He says you see a lot of celebrities getting tattooed and people want to copy them.

questions.q: What does Lee Clements think is a negative side of this trend?
options: Tattoos feel less special and individual
Parlours are too busy
Tattoo designs are getting worse
People regret their tattoos more often
questions.why: He says it 'dilutes that value a little bit' when tattoos become a fashion thing.

questions.q: Has Rob changed his mind about getting a tattoo by the end?
options: Yes, he wants one on his back
Yes, he booked an appointment
He is still thinking about it
No, he's not getting one soon
questions.why: He says, 'I'm not going to get one anytime soon.'
